articles.author: Uzi Baruch
articles.title: IDF eliminates terrorist who planned attack killing four soldiers
articles.description: IDF, ISA, eliminate Nukhba terrorist involved in planning explosive attack that killed four soldiers from IDF's Battalion 52 last year.
articles.content:
The IDF and ISA on Wednesday announced that earlier this week, they eliminated a terrorist who was responsible for helping plan the attack in which four IDF soldiers were killed.
